project_type: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite SPA (EdTech platform for Libyan university)
build_system: Vite 5.4 with TypeScript compiler (tsc -b && vite build)
test_framework: No test framework configured - validation is via tsc typecheck and vite build
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'npx tsc -b --noEmit' in frontend/ to verify no TypeScript errors. 2. Run 'npx vite build' to verify CSS and bundling works without errors.
setup_instructions: Project is already cloned at /projects/sandbox/madarek on branch feat/radical-redesign. Node modules already available if node_modules exists, otherwise need npm install (blocked by INTEGRATIONS_ONLY).
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - cannot npm install, cannot fetch Google Fonts from CDN. Must use system font fallbacks. Cannot run dev server to visually verify. Validation limited to TypeScript typecheck and static analysis.
contribution_requirements: All existing functionality must be preserved. RTL layout required. Theme switch (light/dark/system) must work without flash. prefers-reduced-motion must be respected.
key_patterns: CSS custom properties (tokens) in :root and [data-theme] selectors. BEM-like class naming. Theme via data-theme attribute on <html>. ThemeToggle component syncs store to DOM. Reveal component for scroll animations. Landing page is a single React component with CSS class-based styling.
directory_structure: frontend/src/styles/ contains 19 CSS files (12,424 total lines). frontend/src/pages/ has LandingPage.tsx (main public page) and role-specific dashboard pages in subdirs. frontend/src/components/layout/ has AppShell, Sidebar, Topbar, ThemeToggle. Theme state in frontend/src/stores/theme.store.ts. Entry: frontend/src/main.tsx imports all 19 CSS files.
